workstream: qgraph memory-first: integer stored vectors (Store::I8/I16) and one 1-bit RaBitQ code per vertex against the data centroid in a separate compact array (Codes::Vertex), instead of per-edge residual codes in the vertex block (Codes::Edge, the previous layout, still the default).
protocol: public-bench ann-qgraph --holdout 2000: every (n/2000)-th train vector is a query and is left out of the index; truth is exact cosine over the rest. test.f32 and neighbors.i32 were not read. Single thread, one query at a time, k=10.
screening_note: Screening runs were untimed (no lock, --max-load 1000) on a machine at load 40-135; their QPS and build_secs are NOT results. Their recall and mean_exact_evals_per_query are deterministic and machine-independent and were used for design choices.
timed_note: Timed runs ran under /Volumes/A/.hms-target/timed.sh with --max-load 3 and --repeats 3. A timed number whose load_gate_met is false is not a result.
qps_at_recall_method: Pareto frontier of (recall, qps), linear interpolation in log(QPS) between bracketing points, identical to benchmarks/public/evaluate.py qps_at_recall.
